bead.title: harness-pty: list Claude and Codex TUI models via direct PTY
bead.description: Implement required model and reasoning-level discovery for the primary TUI harnesses through the ADR-002 direct PTY library and cassette layer. Model listing is core functionality for Claude and Codex, not optional. This bead must prove discovery through replayable evidence, not only parser fixtures. It also owns the Claude reasoning/effort mapping decision: use an installed-CLI source of truth when available, otherwise a version-pinned compatibility table with freshness metadata.
bead.acceptance:
1. ListModels for codex returns a non-empty authenticated model list from direct PTY TUI discovery or a documented direct CLI equivalent, without tmux.
2. ListModels for claude returns a non-empty authenticated model list from direct PTY TUI discovery or a documented direct CLI equivalent, without tmux.
3. ListReasoning for codex reports supported reasoning/effort values from the harness source of truth or a version-pinned compatibility table with freshness metadata.
4. ListReasoning for claude owns the Claude-specific effort mapping decision: use stable installed-CLI evidence such as --effort help when available, or a version-pinned compatibility table with freshness metadata; stale or unverified mappings leave the capability gap/blocked.
5. SetReasoning for codex and claude rejects unsupported reasoning values before run execution with normalized errors and includes evidence of the applied adapter flag/config when supported.
6. Unsupported model values are rejected before run execution with normalized errors.
7. Discovery failures leave the capability visible as unavailable/gap, not optional or silently empty.
8. Unit tests cover parsing, empty/changed menus, unsupported selections, PTY failures, Claude mapping freshness, and stale compatibility metadata.
9. Replay tests use sanitized cassettes for Claude and Codex model-list and reasoning-level discovery flows.
10. Opt-in record tests can refresh authenticated Claude and Codex model/reasoning cassettes, serialize per harness account, and fail fast without accepted artifacts when auth, binary, quota, transport prerequisites, or account locks are unavailable.
11. go test ./... passes; AGENT_HARNESS_RECORD=1 go test -tags=integration -run model passes in an authenticated environment.
